full_judgment:
6. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing for the petitioners, has submitted that the trial Court as well as the appellate Court dismissed the suit of the plaintiffs on misreading and non-consideration of the material evidence on record and the learned Judge of the High Court Division also failed to apply her judicial mind to consider the materials on record in its proper perspective and thus erred in law in passing the impugned judgment and order affirming' those of the appellate Court and as such, the same calls for interference by this Court. 

 8. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing for the petitioners, could not show before us any misreading and non-consideration of the material evidence by the Courts below as well as the High Court Division resulting in an erroneous decision in dismissing the plaintiffs suit though he argued so.
